name: ha-fast-kiosk
description: Show a Home Assistant dashboard card on a slow wall tablet or smart display without loading the Home Assistant frontend.

scripts.build: esbuild src/boot.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=chrome90 --legal-comments=eof "--banner:js=/* ha-fast-kiosk (MIT) https://github.com/Davette10/ha-fast-kiosk. Bundles home-assistant-js-websocket (Apache-2.0), see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md */" --outfile=dist/boot.js && esbuild src/sw.js --minify --outfile=dist/sw.js && cp src/index.html src/theme.css src/config.example.json src/version.txt dist/
